description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Shuu Tsukiyama from Tokyo Ghoul. Features rose appreciation, a coffee-cup greeting, dramatic book reading, a dropped-rose recovery, attentive waiting, a small leap and three articulated running views. The fully closed plum suit, simplified lapels and harmless props are creative adaptations. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
